items.title: R.C.H. Smith Interview, 1975-10-02
items.q: In the 30s and I knew him down here

ctx.x: Oh, I hope so because I certainly needed that because I didn't name chords by name but I sure relied on them to play on top of my own, what little ability I had, my intuitive and playing by ear. I could sure tell a bad chord when I heard it and I would get really frozen up if I heard a bad one coming at me. But if I heard good chords and some good rhythm, I sounded indeed better than I was. I'm just sorry I never had a chance to record with the Ori band but he did not do any recording in that period.

There was several piano players out there that I think about. Like, I don't suppose you ever knew Lionel Reason. No, I don't remember that name. He lived in California for a while and he was with Ori and, well, previously he'd been with King Oliver. No, he'd been way back. Way back.
In the 30s and I knew him down here
